name: Portal Hub H2-45-100
description: A bent hawthorn spreads its blossom over an apparently ordinary patch of grass. Beneath it lies a compact circular hall, its ivory arches edged in gold and its doorways filled with trembling blue light. The central column rises towards the living roots overhead; a tidy alcove holds the fittings used to tend the doors.
atmosphere: Sheltered stillness beneath a wind-bent tree. Soft amber lamps warm the blue light, and footsteps carry clearly around the curved walls.
notes: A local branch of the H2-45 door network, with a mapped connection to Portal Hub H2-45-99. The tree conceals a secured surface exit. Destination emblems identify doors to those who understand them; they are not enough to grant an unfamiliar visitor unrestricted routing access. Use this small hub to contrast everyday Fey travel with human stories of disappearing beneath a Fairy Tree. Other destinations remain unspecified until authored.
